name: What kind of compensation can I get from a trip and fall lawsuit?
description: You can seek compensation for medical bills, lost wages, pain and suffering, and other related costs incurred due to your injury.

mainEntity.name: What kind of compensation can I get from a trip and fall lawsuit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compensation in a trip and fall lawsuit can cover various damages you sustained. This may include economic damages such as medical expenses (past and future), lost wages or earning capacity, and other out-of-pocket costs related to your injury. Non-economic damages, like pain and suffering, emotional distress, and loss of enjoyment of life, may also be sought. The specific amount varies greatly depending on the severity of your injuries, their impact on your life, and the specifics of the case.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can seek compensation for medical bills, lost wages, pain and suffering, and other related costs incurred due to your injury.
